dropped.finding: The inbound peer-parent evidence lookup keys off `local_ticket.get("ticket_id")` instead of the authoritative binding local id (`local_id`) that is already in hand at the call site. `compute_inbound_mutations` computes `local_id = binding_store.get_local_id(jira_key)` and `local_by_id` is built as `{t.get("ticket_id", t.get("id","")): t}` in run_differs; a ticket carrying only `id` (not `ticket_id`) yields `get_peer_parent("")`, which returns None and silently suppresses every legitimate clear for that ticket.
